meta.purpose: Map each new D1' surrogate to its blueprint reproducible bug in the 392 pool

CF1.blueprint_title: MoE aux_loss accumulated twice with activation checkpointing
CF1.blueprint_root_cause: MoE layer recompute re-runs forward without no_grad, calling save_to_aux_losses_tracker() twice per step. The aux_loss counter ends each step with calls_per_step=2 instead of 1.
CF1.surrogate_invariant: calls_per_step == 1 at end of each training step
CF1.surrogate_bug_signal: buggy aux_loss accumulator is 2x fixed; calls_per_step=2 vs 1

baseline_adaptability.trainaudit: P4 invocation-frequency rule on tracker.save_to_aux_losses_tracker, expected count == 1 per step
baseline_adaptability.traincheck: should infer the invariant 'tracker.calls_per_step == 1 at end of step' from healthy trace
baseline_adaptability.naive: single-step grad/loss difference is sub-percent (aux loss is small), should NOT trigger threshold-based alerting

CM1.blueprint_root_cause: Throughput metrics not using reduce_type=max → partially-reduced values on non-zero ranks
CM1.surrogate_invariant: metric_log_per_rank[0] == metric_log_per_rank[r] for all r at every step
CM1.surrogate_bug_signal: buggy uses max_local (local values pass through), giving rank-disagreement >> 0

baseline_adaptability.trainaudit: P3 cross-rank-replication rule on metric_log entries, expecting cross-rank equality
baseline_adaptability.traincheck: should infer 'metric_log_per_rank[i] == metric_log_per_rank[j]' from healthy trace
baseline_adaptability.naive: buggy throughput per-rank fluctuates around clean local; aggregate-level loss/grad_norm unchanged → naive misses

OF1.blueprint_title: MoE CPU offload grad norm tensor stays on CPU instead of GPU (dtype variant)
OF1.blueprint_root_cause: Offload-restore path silently casts to fp16 instead of preserving fp32, introducing sub-percent precision drift in clip threshold
OF1.surrogate_bug_signal: avg grad_norm differs by ~1e-4 (sub-thousandth-percent); param trajectory diverges over many steps

baseline_adaptability.trainaudit: P1 dtype-preservation rule on offload round-trip; checks output dtype == input dtype
baseline_adaptability.traincheck: may struggle — dtype check requires schema-level annotation; if proxy captures dtype, expected to flag the fp16 truncation
baseline_adaptability.naive: drift is sub-percent and accumulates only over many steps; will NOT trip loss-spike or grad_norm-bound monitor
